create.name: Sangha Live
create.bio:
Sangha Live is an online Buddhist meditation community that meets entirely on the internet, bringing people together from many countries with teachers drawn mostly from the insight (vipassana) world and related traditions. It describes itself as the largest Dharma practice group of its kind online, and its roster of past and present teachers runs to well over a hundred names, from senior figures such as Joseph Goldstein, Tara Brach and Jack Kornfield to a younger generation of insight teachers in Europe and the Americas.

The rhythm is simple. Each weekday morning, European time, there is an hour of live practice with guided meditation and a short teaching, led for a week at a time by one teacher around a theme. On Sundays a ninety-minute session brings a different teacher with a talk and questions. Both are free and supported by donations. Monthly three-hour Days of Practice go deeper, with long sits, on a sliding scale. There are also live multi-week courses, self-paced short courses and a free library of more than a thousand hours of recorded sessions, plus an online space where members can share between sits.

courses.title: Day of Practice with Peace Twesigye – November 21 2026
courses.description: A live three-hour online session with Insight Dialogue teacher Peace Twesigye on receptive awareness: longer sits, movement and relational practice, a teaching on wise attention and time for questions. A replay is sent to everyone registered.

free_resources.title: Daily Meditation
free_resources.description: An hour of live online practice every weekday morning (European time), each week led by a different teacher around a theme, with guided meditation, a short teaching and live chat. Past sessions can be replayed from the same page. Free, with donations welcome.

free_resources.title: Our Offerings
free_resources.description: Sangha Live's overview of its programme: the free Sunday Sangha talks and weekday sits, sliding-scale Days of Practice, live and on-demand courses, a free Dharma Library of recorded sessions and its members' community space.
